The investment condominium “Lesco” offers quality comparable to condominiums for sale at a price that makes it easy for wealthy individuals to acquire as income-producing property, and the investment wooden apartment “Atelese” has as its strengths planning suited to each location and control of construction costs through wood construction. entries.85cdce5c137cdda0: It states its management philosophy as “to pursue material and spiritual prosperity together with all stakeholders through the excellent products and services we create,” and says it aims for sustainable growth and enhancement of corporate value by providing optimal living environments that match diverse customer needs, including the sale of high-quality, price-competitive ready-built houses, sale of investment properties for wealthy individuals, and construction contracts for mid-to-high-end custom-built homes. It has set its slogan for the fiscal year ending December 2026 as “Totonoeru”, and identifies the development of its earnings base and personnel structure as important management issues. For ready-built houses, it aims to secure stable earnings while maintaining the current business scale; for investment properties, it aims to increase its owned properties and build up rental income; and for its consolidated subsidiary Morizo Co., Ltd., it aims for an early return to profitability and a shift to a phase of investment recovery.
